subject: gk
question: The duration of the 12th five year plan was from _______ to ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2012 - 2017**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The 12th Five Year Plan**, spanning from** 2012 to 2017**, marked the culmination of India's Five Year Plan era.
 
• Despite the challenging global economic climate, Deputy Chairman of the Planning Commission, Mr. Montek Singh Ahluwalia, expressed skepticism about achieving an average growth rate of 8% over the subsequent five years.
 
• However, the final growth target of 8% was endorsed during the National Development Council (NDC) meeting in New Delhi.
 
• The Planning Commission aimed to secure NDC approval by September, setting a deadline for the process.
 
• The council was expected to convene after July, contingent upon the Prime Minister's schedule. The primary focus of the plan was on improving health outcomes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a5c6c1a51584cd0949cfa1d4f5e83078348736110fc515584ac8551f84d7adec.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The Eleventh Five-Year Plan, **spanning from 2007 to 2012, aimed to achieve sustainable and inclusive growth by implementing reforms across various sectors.
 
• **The Eighth Five-Year Plan** was skipped in 1990, and the years 1990-91 and 1991-92 were treated as Annual Plans due to economic instability, particularly the crisis in foreign exchange reserves.
